master.definition_en: Infections of the nervous system caused by fungi of the genus aspergillus, most commonly aspergillus fumigatus. Aspergillus infections may occur in immunocompetent hosts, but are more prevalent in individuals with immunologic deficiency syndromes. The organism may spread to the nervous system from focal infections in the lung, mastoid region, sinuses, inner ear, bones, eyes, gastrointestinal tract, and heart. Sinus infections may be locally invasive and enter the intracranial compartment, producing meningitis, fungal; cranial neuropathies; and abscesses in the frontal lobes of the brain. (From Joynt, Clinical Neurology, 1998, Ch 27, pp62-3)

curated.name_zh: 遗传性抗凝血酶缺乏症
aliases_zh: 先天性抗凝血酶Ⅲ缺乏症
curated.category: 遗传性易栓症与凝血障碍
curated.lethality_detail_zh: 平时终生处于无症状隐匿高凝状态，常无任何预警信号；一旦遭遇手术、妊娠/产褥期、外伤或长途制动等诱因，极易突发急性深静脉血栓（DVT）或直接以大面积致死性肺栓塞（PE）为首发表现，数分钟至数小时内因急性右心衰竭及呼吸循环衰竭猝死。抗凝血酶承担血浆70%–80%的生理抗凝活性，缺乏者可出现肝素抵抗；纯合子完全缺乏通常胚胎期致死，且中国队列显示SERPINC1无义/截短突变携带者较错义突变VTE风险显著升高（HR=2.29）且发病更早（中位27岁 vs 32岁）。
curated.treatability_summary_zh: 目前尚无根治性基因修复疗法获批，但可通过高危期预防性抗凝、规范长期抗凝及围术期/分娩期人抗凝血酶Ⅲ浓缩物替代治疗有效控制血栓复发；最大临床痛点在于大量无症状携带者在首次致命性肺栓塞前未被筛查识别。

annual_deaths_global.range_or_note: WHO GHE与IHME GBD未单列遗传性抗凝血酶缺乏症死亡统计（死亡通常归入急性肺栓塞或VTE）；随访队列显示一旦确诊并规范抗凝，长期总体预期寿命接近常人，但未诊治急性大面积PE可数分钟至数小时致死
annual_deaths_global.source: Orphanet ORPHA:82 / Leiden Thrombophilia Follow-up Studies

annual_deaths_china.range_or_note: 中国尚无全国性单列死亡登记；国内VTE队列中SERPINC1突变携带者常于青壮年期首发危重血栓，无义突变者累积VTE风险明显高于错义突变（HR=2.29）
annual_deaths_china.source: 《易栓症诊断与防治中国指南（2021年版）》 / PubMed PMID:27863268

epidemiology.prevalence_global: 一般人群杂合子时点患病率约 1–5 / 10,000（约0.02%–0.05%，Orphanet ORPHA:82）

clinical_management.acute_emergency_protocol_zh: 高度警惕‘肝素抵抗’：普通肝素/低分子肝素依赖抗凝血酶发挥作用，严重AT缺乏患者单用肝素可能APTT/抗Xa不达标。怀疑大面积PE或围术期危机时，应立即给予人抗凝血酶Ⅲ浓缩物或新鲜冰冻血浆（FFP）恢复AT活性至80%–120%并联合抗凝；极高危大面积PE按急性PE抢救路径行系统性溶栓（阿替普酶等）或介入取栓/ECMO支持；替代抗凝可选不依赖AT的直接凝血酶/Xa抑制剂或磺达肝癸钠（注：磺达肝癸钠仍需AT介导）及阿加曲班/比伐卢定。

research_progress.breakthroughs_and_trials_zh: 2022–2025年基因治疗与RNA工程在SERPINC1通路形成双向突破：一方面，针对遗传性抗凝血酶缺乏症的临床前研究已利用CRISPR-Cas9修复患者来源iPSC肝细胞中的SERPINC1致病突变，移植后可稳定分泌正常抗凝血酶并逆转易栓表型（PubMed PMID:36449603）；另一方面，反向利用GalNAc偶联siRNA靶向沉默肝脏SERPINC1 mRNA的Fitusiran（Qfitlia）在ATLAS 3期临床系列取得成功后于2025年获FDA批准用于血友病（PMC12767935），证实LNP/GalNAc-siRNA靶向肝脏凝血调控网络具备高度可控性与成药性。此外，靶向FXI/FXIa的新型抗凝药（如Abelacimab 3期LILAC-TIMI 76）有望进一步降低遗传性高危人群长期抗凝的出血风险。
research_progress.key_unmet_needs_zh: 1）无症状年轻高危人群缺乏高性价比普筛策略（现行AT活性检测受急性血栓消耗和肝素治疗干扰易致假阳性/假阴性）；2）国内血源性人抗凝血酶Ⅲ浓缩物供应紧缺；3）尚无已上市的体内基因编辑或mRNA替代根治药物。

master.name_en: hereditary motor and sensory neuropathy type 6
master.definition_en: A rare axonal hereditary motor and sensory neuropathy disease characterized by progressive, peripheral, axonal sensorimotor neuropathy (of variable severity), affecting predominantly the distal lower limbs, associated with progressive, variably severe, optic atrophy, which frequently leads to visual loss. Patients typically present distal limb muscle weakness and atrophy, hypo/areflexia, foot deformities, poor visual acuity (often with a central scotoma), nystagmus, and reduced peripheral and nocturnal vision. Additional reported manifestations include sensorineural hearing loss, major joint contractures, anosmia, scoliosis/lumbar hyperlordosis, cognitive impairment and vocal cord paresis.

master.definition_en: A rare disorder of the anterior segment of the eye characterized by ocular infection by human-pathogenic fungi, most commonly Aspergillus, Candida, or Fusarium species, which gain access into the corneal stroma through a defect in the corneal epithelium. Risk factors include trauma, ocular surface disease, contact lenses, or immunocompromised state. Patients present with pain, foreign body sensation, redness, photophobia, tearing, secretion, or blurred vision. The condition may be complicated by corneal destruction and perforation, endophthalmitis, scleritis, and panophthalmitis.
